Active-stream world, target, arm, and claim contract.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal operationalizes one deliberately narrow Paper-1 slice of the Dream-LoRA-Think thesis: a life matters only when remembered, life-specific causal structure changes an information-seeking action; that action creates otherwise unavailable public evidence; target-blind offline processing incorporates that evidence; and the changed memory helps a later unseen executed action after raw history exceeds the tokenizer-exact native envelope. Across one life, working state and plans are temporary; public action/outcome events are an immutable episodic record; deterministic witnessed atoms and model-owned SELF semantic records are explicit declarative memory with append-only provenance/status; and checkpoint text snapshots are the durable paper treatment. The frozen base/controller supplies prior intelligence and the prompted operation policy. No per-life LoRA is trained in the current text study: LoRA is only a future, life-reset realization of an identical accepted corpus, explicitly denied credit for dreaming, truth, compression, planning, graph storage, or policy learning. The design therefore tests finite causal-map acquisition, retention, cross-era composition, and an action-conditioned memory flywheel, not generic self-learning, autonomous discovery, learned scheduling, semantic compression, naturalistic development, or unbounded improvement.
graph_delta_interpretation: The fixed-source edge is removed: arms share a presealed latent root, episode starts, goals, menus, costs, caps, and target roster, but each arm chooses actions and owns the resulting public history. Four causal edges replace playback. First, a checkpoint memory can redirect one diagnostic probe. Second, only the executed probe creates its public observation and causal coverage. Third, after the assigned AUTH/TWIN/NULL exploration object and all its descendants are unmounted, the branch public event plus a common authentic prior and common Dream-1 bytes can create a target-blind delta under assignment-independent paired compiler draws. Fourth, a fresh evaluator installs only common prior plus that delta and executes a later D4 action. The AUTH/TWIN/NULL forks, binding-only substitutions, outcome packet interventions, SELF semantic cut/sham, and h1-through-h6 cumulative products test those edges. Common-history and same-event lanes further separate on-policy history quality from representation/compiler use. Module credit is intentionally factored: the deterministic extractor gets only witnessed-atom credit; the frozen model gets bounded prospective/revision SELF content credit; the sleeper gets syntax, provenance, deduplication, supersession and fixed-view realization credit; the reader gets return fidelity; the resolver gets adaptive query/path and action credit; and P1 plus P2-P4 assign organism-level value. Dreaming is breadth-like only in the supported limited sense that target-blind sleep may replay multiple eligible events and propose multiple local relations/views, whereas target-time thinking follows a goal-conditioned read-dependent path. Neither metaphor means a solver graph is model-visible or stored in weights, and no materialized shortcut is in the primary surface.
loop_delta_interpretation: The ordinary lifetime loop is ACT/OBSERVE -> append public event -> deterministic extraction -> prospective/revision DREAM/SLEEP -> sealed text snapshot -> later goal-conditioned read/act, repeated at presealed opportunities through 6L. Ordinary action attempts and outcomes may become evidence for a later dream once they are sealed as PUBLIC_LIVED_EVENT; fork probe outcomes may enter only the post-unmount branch delta; sterile checkpoint attempts, queries, returns, thoughts, scores, and outcomes are destroyed at item end and never feed a later dream or life. Dream-1 commits bounded four-probe predictions before the decisive outcome; Dream-2 later reads the same committed bytes, common prior, and raw public outcome and chooses RETAIN, REVISE, ABSTAIN, or bounded addition. Unsupported, contradicted, malformed, timed-out, and failed cases remain auditable rather than disappearing. Scheduling is fixed rather than learned: checkpoints are 0.75, 1.5, 3, and 6 times L_native, causal pulses occur only at the three post-native points, and selection/sleep schedules, calls, samples, retries, stop rules, budgets, and failure mappings must be hash-frozen before B0. Target-time cognition is capped at six reader calls, 4,096 query bytes, 16,384 returned bytes, twelve resolver operations, and a presealed four-to-six action cap; missing or illegal operations receive zero with no replacement. The outer science loop is A0 -> A1 -> A2 -> independent review -> exact human scientific-call authorization -> B0 -> B1 -> B2 -> B3 -> later separately authorized C, with no automatic arrow and D unavailable unless text confirmation later passes. Scale means genuinely new cohort mappings across tokenizer-exact context overflow, not filler, replay, or paraphrase; the independent unit is the complete twin-pair world-life root.
claim_delta_interpretation: The proposal retires fixed-source self-improvement and all Paper-1 compression/unbounded-learning language. A positive text result can support only: (1) within finite synthetic PCFL, a randomized chain-complete causal cascade from assigned memory through probe, information gain, new public evidence, readable target-blind delta, used working path, and terminal action; (2) incremental value of generic model-owned prospective/revision text compilation beyond raw action/outcome, action-only, witnessed/mechanical, recurrent-KV, RAG, linked, and rolling conditions under the same online envelope, while reporting unequal offline work; and (3) acquisition, retention, and cross-era D4 action over exactly three post-native points if all four failure-inclusive root composites pass the fixed 26-root IUT. P4 on separate on-policy histories is a whole-system contrast and can include better experience collection; compiler-specific credit comes from P1 interventions and the byte-identical common-history sentinel, not P4 alone. Baseline plateau is optional and must be shown by baseline-specific equivalence intervals rather than inferiority. The September target is construct plus eight-root nonconfirmatory DEV only. No text result establishes LoRA value, and no future DEV LoRA sentinel itself creates a parametric paper claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: State moves through typed, descendant-closed boundaries. Generators/certifiers alone see HIDDEN_TRUTH, target proofs, twin maps, and allocation certificates; scorers may consume them only after actions seal and cannot write cognition. Wake sees current public opportunity, its arm's public lived prefix, and local reader returns. Dream-1 sees eligible past public evidence/prior SELF but not later outcomes; Dream-2 sees exact prospective bytes, common eligible prior, and the later raw public event but no comparator verdict. The sleeper sees eligible public/SELF bytes and provenance, never targets, truth, scores, arm results, or assignment content. The index hosts a frozen snapshot but exposes one local record or NOT_FOUND and no backend metadata. During a fork, only the installer holds AUTH/TWIN/NULL content; the diagnostic actor sees an opaque reader. The resetter may inspect registry handles only to prove destruction and cannot read/hash/forward semantics. The delta compiler receives common prior, common Dream-1, branch public event, and pre-fork assignment-independent seed inputs; assignment labels, handles, timing, errors, cache state, and assigned content are forbidden. The evaluation installer reconstructs common prior plus delta, and a fresh actor may derive only ephemeral goal-conditioned queries. Goal, query, return, workspace, outcome, and process die after each target; pre/post life-object hashes must match. Taint includes metadata, filenames, lengths, counts, ordering, candidate catalogs, latency, retries, seeds, caches, and selector channels. The trusted DEV selector is one-way and sees only prospectively allowed aggregates after all cells seal; it may choose the already frozen AS-EXT candidate and resource/go/calibration/stop disposition, never cognition. Fresh-life reset includes every episodic, semantic, index, candidate, adapter, optimizer, conversation, RNG, process, provider, and temporary-state surface with canaries.
acceptance_test_interpretation: PAS_T01_TOTAL_WORLD_OPPORTUNITY_TARGET_AND_CONTEXT measures whether allocation is total, pre-outcome, genuinely information-growing, tokenizer-exact, age-valid, twin/clone-complete, and failure-inclusive; it measures the advertised lifetime/world substrate, not model efficacy. PAS_T02_ON_POLICY_ACTION_AND_D4_HEADROOM measures representation-neutral terminal action validity and whether integrative targets require adaptive multi-event retrieval while the exact program succeeds and target-only/nonadaptive routes fail; recurrent KV success is an allowed comparator, so the test does not guarantee SELF advantage. PAS_T03_RANDOMIZED_UNMOUNTED_MEDIATION measures the complete randomized causal-cascade links and paired-seed/unmount integrity, plus same-event/common-history, binding, outcome, and semantic interventions inside P1; it advertises a causal cascade, not formal mediation. PAS_T04_MODEL_OWNED_COMPILER_AND_MECHANICAL_CONTROL measures whether frozen generic prospective/revision SELF content adds executed integrative value and is necessary under interventions beyond supplied extraction/mechanical/raw controls; it does not show the compiler policy was learned. PAS_T05_TEXT_BASELINES_AND_DEV_SELECTION measures honest native baselines, equal-atom adaptive versus nonadaptive use, strongest-comparator selection, full resource accounting, and the one-way selector firewall; it prevents weak-baseline credit but DEV remains nonconfirmatory. PAS_T06_LIFETIME_STATISTICS_POWER_AND_PLATEAU measures the independent-root, failure-inclusive P1-P4 decision, fixed 26-root/908-row roster, variance/diagnostic/simulation feasibility, acquisition, acquired-and-retained old knowledge, strongest-baseline cross-era AUC, and strict named-baseline equivalence; its advertised .806317 joint figure is prospective planning conditional on the frozen assumptions, not achieved evidence. PAS_T07_DESCENDANT_VISIBILITY_TAINT_RESET measures every component and covert metadata channel, paired-seed equality, postfork unmount, sterile evaluation, selector flow, and cross-life reset via mutation tests; it establishes boundary conformance only. PAS_T08_RESOURCE_CALENDAR_AND_STAGE_LOCK measures that the ordered killer gates and complete surface fit frozen device/provider, cost, storage, transfer, and review limits without pruning, and keeps September DEV distinct from later confirmation. PAS_T09_A4_REVISION_SENTINEL measures only C1-C3 integrity: all preassigned A4 rows, representation-neutral terminal V, zero-valued failures, and sterility; positive contradiction/revision/recovery/retention efficacy is explicitly not required and cannot affect P1-P4. PAS_T10_CONDITIONAL_LORA_READER_AND_CAUSAL_SENTINEL is correctly disposed as NOT_REQUESTED_STAGE_D for current text C1-C3 with no artifact; it measures reader/substrate life binding only if a future separately ratified LoRA claim makes it mandatory. PAS_T11_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION_AND_CLAIM_FIREWALL measures raw reproduction and claim-bounded review with approve-narrow, null, NOT_RUN, or reject all valid and non-authorizing. PAS_T12_PREMODEL_COGNITION_BYTE_FREEZE measures that every prompt, schema, serializer, model/sample setting, reader/index/candidate/cut/retry/stop/failure byte, online envelope, analysis code, and paired-seed implementation is frozen and independently reviewed before scientific calls, followed by exact human call/token/cost/root/stage authorization; any cognition change restarts DEV.
assumptions: The exact proposal SHA supplied by the task and independently recomputed is the intended change.json binding, while context_files bind the directive followed by the workflow's 34 context paths in workflow order.
A 'dream' in this proposal means the frozen resolver's target-blind prospective/revision compilation calls; it is not evidence that a shared dream/think controller or scheduler has been learned.
The exact program's itemwise value one and the nonadaptive-reader failure are construct preconditions, not baselines that SELF must outperform.
All ordinary and fork action outcomes described as evidence are public environment outputs; hidden engine facts remain offline scoring/certification state.
Text snapshots, indices, witnessed atoms, and SELF records reset per life even when a frozen controller or future LOOP policy is shared across lives.

ambiguities.question: How do bounded multiple model samples become one canonical SELF semantic set when samples disagree, given that deterministic sleep may not use correctness filtering?
ambiguities.impact: The exact A2 rule can shift coverage, false-memory rate, semantic-cut eligibility, compiler ownership, and stochastic dependence without violating the high-level contract.

ambiguities.question: What exact target-blind schedule triggers Dream-1/Dream-2 and snapshot compilation between ordinary opportunities, apart from the four evaluation checkpoints?
ambiguities.impact: Cadence changes accessible evidence, compiler cost, revision latency, and the effective causal path; it must be frozen rather than inferred from checkpoint notation.

ambiguities.question: Which target-independent action-policy details keep opportunity starts comparable after arms create different public histories, failures, and costs?
ambiguities.impact: Without exact transition/reset semantics, P4 can mix memory value with unequal reachable state or opportunity exposure beyond the intended on-policy effect.

ambiguities.question: Which append-only SELF lifecycle statuses are actually reader-visible at each checkpoint, and how are superseded, provisional, abstained, or contradicted records represented under the byte cap?
ambiguities.impact: Reader exposure determines whether revision helps, whether false claims remain actionable, and what semantic cuts truly remove.

ambiguities.question: How are legitimate native offline budgets chosen for SELF, linked memory, rolling summary, MECH, and RAG when only the online envelope is equal?
ambiguities.impact: Capability claims remain valid with reported unequal work, but any interpretation as efficiency or practical superiority depends on the future frozen resource policy.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The primary text surface should not be described as demonstrating the full Dream-LoRA-Think organism or the one-resolver/two-regime architecture.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: It contains no LoRA, no learned LOOP policy or scheduler, no recurrent breadth-growth requirement, and no materialized shortcut. It tests a frozen prompted prospective/revision text compiler plus a frozen resolver over finite causal memory.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the paper claim and diagrams explicitly at the finite text-memory systems rung; label the broader architecture as motivation and reserve organism/LoRA/controller claims for separately powered stages.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: P4 cannot by itself attribute superiority to compilation or memory representation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Its arms act on-policy and therefore receive different evidence streams; this is desired whole-system flywheel behavior but combines evidence acquisition, representation, retrieval, and use.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use P4 only for the whole-arm cross-era action claim and require P1's randomized pulse plus byte-identical common-history and same-event contrasts for compiler-specific wording.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The design does not yet test adaptive sleep pressure, learned exploration allowance, or learned retry/stop behavior.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Checkpoint cadence, prompts, selection schedule, operation budgets, retries, and stopping are prospectively frozen. Their effectiveness is supplied controller design, not within-life or across-life learning.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Report scheduling as fixed infrastructure and treat logged successful/failed trajectories only as future LOOP-policy training material.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Even a complete pass would not substantiate the owner's broad phrase 'beats other SOTA systems' without tight qualification.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The proposal covers a finite synthetic family and a registered comparator set under a shared online envelope but possibly unequal offline resources; external validity, generic SOTA, efficiency, and unbounded scaling are forbidden.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Name the exact comparator and PCFL range in every superiority sentence, report the total resource vector, and preserve external/naturalistic validation as a later study.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The P1 minimum over fifteen root-level components is a defensible intersection encoding but creates a non-smooth, potentially low-variance or atom-heavy statistic whose planned t test may be fragile.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Taking minima of bounded nested binary-link contrasts can concentrate mass and make eight-root variance/normality diagnostics uninformative or fail even when component mechanisms differ meaningfully.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Do not change the registered decision post hoc; require the frozen pathological-distribution diagnostic and stress simulation exactly as written, treat any failure as calibration-only, and report every component descriptively so a null is interpretable.

open_questions: Whether to ratify these exact proposal bytes and only the stated non-execution architecture scope after critique and consensus.
Whether the narrow finite synthetic text-memory paper target is an acceptable Paper-1 slice of the broader Dream-LoRA-Think thesis.
Whether a later implementation scope should resolve the compiler aggregation, ordinary sleep cadence, status-readability, and native offline-resource ambiguities before A0-A2.
Whether, after fresh A0-A2 review, to authorize exact hash-bound scientific model/provider calls, tokens, costs, roots, and stages; no current directive or interpretation supplies that authority.
Whether any future Stage C or Stage D work should be separately authorized after its prerequisite evidence, resource lock, and independent review.
